verdict.rationale: Replicate documents a continuously growing catalog of open-source models, with community-published models and new ones "added every day." That implies fresh models arrive regularly, but nothing documents how quickly newly released open-weight models appear after their public release. Self-deploying via Cog is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: any evidence of time-to-availability for new open-weight releases, examples of day-one or same-week launches, and independent corroboration of catalog freshness.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release

citations.quote: Thousands of open-source machine learning models have been contributed by our community and more are added every day.
Our community has already published thousands of models that are ready to use in production.
